liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **St. Stephen** (2 reviews): This St. Stephen, like the Franklin's Tower after it, is called an unusual and especially interesting version; The reviewer says Oteil played poorly on St. Stephen, with errors throughout [8][10]
- **Birdsong** (1 review): Jam drifts so far out the listener doubted it was still the song, then returns forcefully and wins over the crowd [8]
- **U.S. Blues** (1 review): U.S. Blues, closing the St. Stephen and Franklin's sequence, came as a welcome surprise [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **D&C 20180218 Mexico T-01**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **D&C 20180218 Mexico T-02**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **D&C 20180218 Mexico T-03**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **D&C 20180218 Mexico T-04**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **D&C 20180218 Mexico T-05**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **D&C 20180218 Mexico T-06**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **D&C 20180218 Mexico T-07**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **D&C 20180218 Mexico T-08**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]

## The recordings

- **DeadCo2018-02-18.DeadCo2018-02-18** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 177 min [1]
- **DeadCo2018-02-18.travitz.schoepsMK4V.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 177 min; rated 3.29/5 by 7 [3]. Said about its sound: A listener finds the recording from the Playing in the Sand event very clear [7]
- **DeadCo2018-02-18**: audience recording; 18 songs; 178 min [2]

## Around the show

- One listener thought the band was off form and that Bob sounded exhausted [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **DeadCo2018-02-18.DeadCo2018-02-18**: taped by Jon Pasternak; transferred by StPatric; source: AUD [1]. Also: Oade M248 mics into an SD722 recorder at 24/48, then iZotope RX Advance, Adobe Audition, CDwave, TLH, and FLAC 16 [1]
- **DeadCo2018-02-18.travitz.schoepsMK4V.flac16**: taped by Jeff Travitz; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: CMC64V'>V3>SD744t [3]. Also: Schoeps CMC64V mics through Grace Design Lunatec V3 into a Sound Devices 744t, then Sound Forge, CDWAV and TLH to FLAC; Keith Litzenberger processed and uploaded this version; Nick Carbonetta loaned the CMC6 microphone components [3]
- **DeadCo2018-02-18**: taped by Mike Mahoney; transferred by Mike Mahoney; source: Audience Recording [2]
